description: This Java class provides services for integrating with SagePay payment gateway, including methods for authorization, capture, refund, void, and release of payments, as well as building customer billing info from context data.

classes.name: SagePayPaymentServices
classes.description: A service class providing methods for processing payments via SagePay, including authorization, capture, refund, void, and release operations, as well as building billing info.

methods.name: buildCustomerBillingInfo
methods.description: Constructs billing information map from context data, including card details and address, for SagePay transactions.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Handles credit card authorization request, calling processCardAuthorisationPayment if payment preference is valid.

methods.name: processCardAuthorisationPayment
methods.description: Performs the actual authorization by calling SagePayPaymentAuthentication service and processes the response.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Handles credit card capture, calling processCardCapturePayment.

methods.name: processCardCapturePayment
methods.description: Performs capture of authorized payment via SagePayPaymentAuthorisation service.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Processes refund request, deciding between refund or void based on transaction age.

methods.name: processCardRefundPayment
methods.description: Performs refund operation via SagePayPaymentRefund service.

methods.name: processCardVoidPayment
methods.description: Performs void operation via SagePayPaymentVoid service.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Handles release of held funds, calling processCardReleasePayment.

methods.name: processCardReleasePayment
methods.description: Performs release of funds via SagePayPaymentRelease service.
